main.summary: Exception thrown when a data protection operation fails and its rollback also fails.
main.remarks: The operation did not complete successfully, and automatic rollback could not restore the prior state. The destination, backup, and staging paths identify files that may require manual recovery. The inner exception contains the original operation error and rollback errors.

property.name: Operation
property.summary: Gets the name of the failed data protection operation, such as EncryptData or DecryptData.

property.name: DestinationPath
property.summary: Gets the destination file path involved in rollback, when available.

property.name: BackupPath
property.summary: Gets the backup file path requiring recovery, when available.

property.name: StagingPath
property.summary: Gets the staging file path requiring recovery, when available.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initializes an exception describing a failed operation and failed rollback.
constructor.param: Name of the failed data protection operation.
Destination file path involved in rollback, when available.
Backup file path requiring recovery, when available.
Staging file path requiring recovery, when available.
